# iosxe_interface_vrrp (Resource)

This resource can manage a VRRPv3 group on an interface (`vrrp <group> address-family ipv4|ipv6`). Both address families of a group are managed by the same resource: setting `ipv4_primary_address` or `ipv6_primary_address` enables that family, removing it removes the family, and destroying the resource removes the group. At least one family must be configured, and `fhrp version vrrp v3` is required (see `iosxe_fhrp`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_interface_vrrp" "example" {
  type                 = "Vlan"
  name                 = "123"
  group_id             = 1
  ipv4_primary_address = "192.0.2.254"
  ipv4_secondary_addresses = [
    {
      address   = "192.0.2.253"
      secondary = true
    }
  ]
  ipv4_priority              = 110
  ipv4_preempt_delay_minimum = 30
  ipv4_timers_advertise      = 3000
  ipv4_description           = "VRRP-GROUP-1"
  ipv4_tracks = [
    {
      object_id = "1"
      decrement = 20
      shutdown  = false
    }
  ]
  ipv4_shutdown        = false
  ipv6_primary_address = "fe80::1"
  ipv6_prefixes = [
    {
      prefix = "2001:DB8::FFFF/64"
    }
  ]
  ipv6_priority              = 120
  ipv6_preempt_delay_minimum = 30
  ipv6_timers_advertise      = 3000
  ipv6_description           = "VRRP-GROUP-1-IPV6"
  ipv6_tracks = [
    {
      object_id = "1"
      decrement = 20
      shutdown  = false
    }
  ]
  ipv6_shutdown = false
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) VRRP group number
  - Range: `1`-`255`
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) Interface type
  - Choices: `GigabitEthernet`, `TwoGigabitEthernet`, `FiveGigabitEthernet`, `TenGigabitEthernet`, `TwentyFiveGigE`, `FortyGigabitEthernet`, `FiftyGigabitEthernet`, `HundredGigE`, `Vlan`, `Port-channel`, `Port-channel-subinterface/Port-channel`, `BDI`

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `ipv4_description` (String) Group description
- `ipv4_preempt_delay_minimum` (Number) Seconds to delay before preempting
  - Range: `0`-`3600`
- `ipv4_primary_address` (String) Virtual primary IPv4 address. Setting it enables the IPv4 address family for the group, and removing it removes the IPv4 address family
- `ipv4_priority` (Number) Priority level
  - Range: `1`-`254`
- `ipv4_secondary_addresses` (Attributes List) Secondary virtual IPv4 addresses (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4_secondary_addresses))
- `ipv4_shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown the VRRP group
- `ipv4_timers_advertise` (Number) Advertisement interval in milliseconds
  - Range: `100`-`40950`
- `ipv4_tracks` (Attributes List) Object tracking configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4_tracks))
- `ipv6_description` (String) Group description
- `ipv6_preempt_delay_minimum` (Number) Seconds to delay before preempting
  - Range: `0`-`3600`
- `ipv6_prefixes` (Attributes List) IPv6 prefix addresses (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6_prefixes))
- `ipv6_primary_address` (String) Virtual primary IPv6 link-local address. Setting it enables the IPv6 address family for the group, and removing it removes the IPv6 address family
- `ipv6_priority` (Number) Priority level
  - Range: `1`-`254`
- `ipv6_shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown the VRRP group
- `ipv6_timers_advertise` (Number) Advertisement interval in milliseconds
  - Range: `100`-`40950`
- `ipv6_tracks` (Attributes List) Object tracking configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6_tracks))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

  - Range: `1`-`255`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_interface_vrrp.example "<type>,<name>,<group_id>"
```
